articles.title: Ledger warns Berlin customers as hardware wallet tampering investigation expands
articles.snippet: Ledger advised customers who purchased devices in Berlin since January 2026 to contact support as it investigates suspected hardware implants in Germany and Dubai.

articles.title: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok Helped Plan Terror Attacks in Government Tests
articles.snippet: Federal investigators bypassed safeguards on four popular chatbots, producing viable attack plans within hours.

articles.title: Bitcoin Miners Are Selling Their Stacks to Fund the AI Boom
articles.snippet: MARA sold 13,597 BTC after September and Riot sold 20,264 BTC through September to fund debt repayment and AI data center buildouts, as Glassnode flagged the pair as the main sellers among Bitcoin treasury firms.

articles.title: AI Will Make the Next 12 Months 'a Slaughterhouse' for Crypto Security: Anchorage Exec
articles.snippet: Security chiefs at Solana's Breakpoint said AI is lowering the bar for hackers, as North Korea steps up its attacks on crypto firms.

articles.title: Optimizely Hack Hijacked Ledger, BBC and 176 Other Sites to Swap Crypto Wallet Addresses
articles.snippet: Malicious code served through the website testing platform replaced visitors' wallet addresses with the attacker's and skimmed cards.
